note: Both sets extract a large number of duplicate claims and read points from the Bode plot. Set A correctly extracts the state-space equations, which Set B misses. However, Set A incorrectly estimates the -3 dB and -45 degree points at 0.3 Hz from the plot, contradicting the text which explicitly states the -3 dB point is at 0.25 Hz. Set B correctly identifies the 0.25 Hz point but misidentifies B_d as the 'discrete-time state matrix' (it is the input matrix) and truncates another matrix name. Set A is slightly better for capturing the equations and correctly identifying the matrices.
